rationale: Matches every non-loop consumer's in-process attribute-access convention (release_gate.py, fsm/executor.py, cli/learning_tests.py); removes a needless serialize/deserialize round-trip. The loop-YAML CLI-subprocess convention it departs from is not load-bearing (no process-isolation rationale exists; this file's own apply_update state already imports little_loops internals directly).
rule: Option A: in-process loader (list_records + is_record_stale, attribute access)
alternatives_rejected: Option B: keep subprocess ll-learning-tests list call, reconstruct via LearnTestRecord.from_dict() before calling is_record_stale — matches the loop-YAML CLI convention but adds a redundant to-dict/from-dict round trip for no isolation benefit.
